title: 聚焦離子束分析系統~Focused-ion-beam analysis systems
focus: 離子—固體濺射、束流與光點取捨、液態金屬離子源、雙束幾何、TEM 薄片損傷與切削速率校正~Ion–solid sputtering, current versus spot size, liquid-metal ion sources, dual-beam geometry, TEM-lamella damage and milling-rate calibration
summary: 從 30 keV 鎵離子在固體中的碰撞串級出發，理解聚焦離子束如何以奈米精度移除與沉積材料，再把離子源、靜電離子柱、SEM／FIB 雙束幾何、TEM 薄片的非晶化與鎵植入、束流與切削速率校正以及切片斷層重建整合成可交接的分析工程紀錄。~Start from the collision cascade of 30 keV gallium ions in a solid to see how a focused ion beam removes and deposits material with nanometre precision, then integrate the ion source, electrostatic ion column, SEM/FIB dual-beam geometry, amorphisation and gallium implantation in TEM lamellae, beam-current and milling-rate calibration and slice-and-view tomography into a transferable analytical engineering record.

units.anchor: 離子碰撞串級與濺射原子~Ion collision cascade and sputtered atoms
units.title: 離子—固體作用與濺射產率~Ion–solid interaction and sputter yield
units.mechanism: 30 keV 的 Ga⁺ 質量 69.7 u，進入固體後主要以核阻擋把能量交給靶原子，形成一連串彈性碰撞的碰撞串級；靠近表面的原子若獲得超過表面結合能（矽約 4.7 eV）的向外動量便離開表面，這就是濺射。鎵在矽中的投射射程約 27 nm，橫向散布約 10 nm，所以切削的最小尺度與損傷深度都由此決定。濺射產率隨入射角上升、在約 75–80° 附近達到最大後下降，並隨材料、晶粒方向（通道效應）而變；同一次撞擊也放出離子誘發二次電子與二次離子，可用於成像與分析。~A 30 keV Ga⁺ ion of mass 69.7 u deposits its energy mainly through nuclear stopping, launching a collision cascade of elastic recoils; atoms near the surface that receive outward momentum above the surface binding energy (about 4.7 eV for silicon) leave the solid, which is sputtering. Gallium's projected range in silicon is about 27 nm with about 10 nm lateral straggle, setting both the smallest milling scale and the damage depth. Sputter yield rises with incidence angle to a maximum near 75–80° and then falls, and it varies with material and grain orientation through channelling; the same impacts emit ion-induced secondary electrons and secondary ions used for imaging and analysis.
units.model: 假設 30 keV Ga⁺ 正向入射矽的濺射產率 Y = 2.2 原子/離子，矽原子體積 Ω = 28.09/(2.329×6.022×10²³) cm³ ≈ 0.0200 nm³：每 nC 電荷移除體積 = (10⁻⁹/1.602×10⁻¹⁹) × 2.2 × 0.0200 nm³ ≈ 6.24×10⁹ × 0.044 nm³ ≈ 0.275 µm³/nC。切一個 20 × 10 × 10 µm（2000 µm³）的截面方塊需 2000/0.275 ≈ 7270 nC，以 30 nA 約 243 s ≈ 4 分鐘（未計再沉積）。~Assuming a sputter yield Y = 2.2 atoms per ion for 30 keV Ga⁺ at normal incidence on silicon and an atomic volume Ω = 28.09/(2.329×6.022×10²³) cm³ ≈ 0.0200 nm³, the volume removed per nanocoulomb is (10⁻⁹/1.602×10⁻¹⁹) × 2.2 × 0.0200 nm³ ≈ 6.24×10⁹ × 0.044 nm³ ≈ 0.275 µm³/nC. A 20 × 10 × 10 µm (2000 µm³) cross-section box needs 2000/0.275 ≈ 7270 nC, about 243 s or 4 minutes at 30 nA before redeposition is counted.
units.verify: 在矽晶片上以固定束流切一組劑量遞增的方塊，以傾斜 SEM 截面、AFM 或觸針輪廓儀量深度，換算 µm³/nC 並與上式比較；對實際關心的材料（銅、鎢、二氧化矽、光阻）重做同一組測試建立材料表，並在 0°、30°、60° 入射角各量一次確認角度依存性。~Mill a series of boxes of increasing dose on a silicon wafer at fixed current, measure their depth by tilted SEM cross-section, AFM or stylus profiler, convert to µm³/nC and compare with the estimate; repeat the series on the materials that matter (copper, tungsten, silicon dioxide, resist) to build a materials table, and measure at 0°, 30° and 60° incidence to confirm the angular dependence.
units.failure: 在高深寬比溝槽中濺出的原子再沉積到側壁，方塊變成 V 形、有效切削速率下降，依時間估算的深度偏深；多晶銅因晶粒方向不同的通道效應使切削速率相差數倍，截面底部凹凸不平並在銅／介電層界面產生假的空洞。~In a high-aspect-ratio trench sputtered atoms redeposit on the sidewalls, the box turns V-shaped and the effective rate falls, so time-based depth estimates run deep; in polycrystalline copper channelling makes milling rates differ several-fold between grain orientations, leaving a rough floor and false voids at copper/dielectric interfaces.
units.misconception: 離子切削對任何材料、晶粒方向與入射角都以相同速率均勻移除。~Ion milling removes every material, grain orientation and incidence angle at the same uniform rate.

units.anchor: 束限光闌與離子探針光點~Beam-defining aperture and ion probe spot
units.title: 束流與光點尺寸的取捨~Beam current versus probe size
units.mechanism: 30 keV 鎵離子的德布羅意波長只有約 0.02 pm，繞射可以忽略；限制光點的是離子源的虛像尺寸、色差與球差。液態金屬離子源的能量散布約 5 eV，在小束流時色差主導，色差盤 d_c = C_c·α·ΔE/E 與收斂半角 α 成正比，而束流 I = π·α²·(dI/dΩ) 與 α² 成正比，所以光點約隨 √I 成長；到 nA 等級時球差與源像放大接手，光點擴大到數百 nm。工程上以一排不同孔徑的束限光闌在「快速移除」與「精細修整」之間切換，氙電漿源則以較低亮度換取 µA 等級的束流。~The de Broglie wavelength of a 30 keV gallium ion is only about 0.02 pm, so diffraction is negligible; the probe is limited by the virtual source size and by chromatic and spherical aberration. A liquid-metal ion source has an energy spread of about 5 eV, so chromatic aberration dominates at small currents: the chromatic disc d_c = C_c·α·ΔE/E grows linearly with the convergence half-angle α while the current I = π·α²·(dI/dΩ) grows with α², so the spot grows roughly as √I; at nanoampere currents spherical aberration and source magnification take over and spots reach hundreds of nanometres. A strip of beam-defining apertures switches between fast removal and fine polishing, while a xenon plasma source trades lower brightness for microampere currents.
units.model: 假設角電流密度 dI/dΩ = 20 µA/sr、色差係數 C_c = 60 mm、ΔE = 5 eV、E = 30 keV：α = 0.3 mrad 時 I = π×(0.3×10⁻³)²×20×10⁻⁶ ≈ 5.7 pA，d_c = 60×10⁻³ × 0.3×10⁻³ × 5/30 000 = 3.0 nm；α = 1 mrad 時 I ≈ 63 pA、d_c = 10 nm。束流多 11 倍，色差盤大 3.3 倍，符合 d ∝ √I。若要以 3 nm 光點切 1 µm³ 需 3.6 nC，在 5.7 pA 要 10.5 分鐘，因此粗切與精修必須分開。~Assuming an angular intensity dI/dΩ = 20 µA/sr, chromatic coefficient C_c = 60 mm, ΔE = 5 eV and E = 30 keV: at α = 0.3 mrad, I = π×(0.3×10⁻³)²×20×10⁻⁶ ≈ 5.7 pA and d_c = 60×10⁻³ × 0.3×10⁻³ × 5/30 000 = 3.0 nm; at α = 1 mrad, I ≈ 63 pA and d_c = 10 nm. Eleven times the current costs 3.3 times the chromatic disc, consistent with d ∝ √I. Removing 1 µm³ with the 3 nm probe needs 3.6 nC, or 10.5 minutes at 5.7 pA, which is why roughing and polishing are separated.
units.verify: 每個光闌以法拉第杯量實際束流，並在碳上錫球或金顆粒樣品以離子誘發二次電子影像量 20–80% 邊緣寬度，畫出光點對束流的對數圖確認小束流段斜率接近 0.5；另以短時間定點照射薄膜，量燒出孔洞的直徑與圓度，檢查光點是否有拖尾或像散。~Measure the real current of every aperture with a Faraday cup and the 20–80% edge width in ion-induced secondary-electron images of tin spheres on carbon or gold particles, plotting probe size against current on log axes to confirm a slope near 0.5 at low current; also dwell the stationary beam briefly on a thin film and measure the diameter and roundness of the resulting hole to check for beam tails or astigmatism.
units.failure: 束限光闌長期被濺射磨成橢圓或邊緣變粗，光點帶出低強度的尾巴，在目標周圍數百 nm 內淺淺地切出光暈並植入鎵，使截面邊緣圓化、表層被非晶化；若用大束流做最後修整，損傷層與再沉積都遠超過要觀察的結構。~A beam-defining aperture sputtered into an ellipse or a ragged edge gives the probe a low-intensity tail that shallowly mills a halo hundreds of nanometres around the target and implants gallium there, rounding cross-section edges and amorphising the surface; using a high current for the final polish leaves damage and redeposition far larger than the structures to be examined.
units.misconception: 離子波長極短，所以聚焦離子束在任何束流下都能維持奈米級光點。~Because ion wavelengths are tiny, a focused ion beam keeps a nanometre spot at any current.

units.anchor: 鎵液態金屬離子源與靜電透鏡~Gallium LMIS and electrostatic lenses
units.title: 液態金屬離子源與靜電離子柱~Liquid-metal ion source and electrostatic ion column
units.mechanism: 鎵液態金屬離子源是一根尖端半徑數 µm 的鎢針，由儲槽中的液態鎵潤濕；萃取電極施加數 kV 電壓，強電場把液面拉成泰勒錐，錐尖只有數 nm，在約 10 V/nm 的場下發生場蒸發而放出 Ga⁺。鎵熔點 29.8 °C、蒸氣壓低、質量適中，是最常用的源材料。離子柱由萃取極、抑制極、聚光鏡、束限光闌條、遮斷器、八極偏轉／消像散器與物鏡組成，全部使用靜電透鏡，因為重離子的磁剛度比同能量電子大數百倍，磁透鏡難以聚焦。氙電漿 FIB 則以感應耦合電漿源取代液態金屬，沒有鎵污染並可給出 µA 束流。~A gallium liquid-metal ion source is a tungsten needle with an apex radius of a few micrometres wetted by liquid gallium from a reservoir; an extractor several kilovolts away pulls the liquid into a Taylor cone whose tip is only a few nanometres across, where a field near 10 V/nm field-evaporates Ga⁺. Gallium's 29.8 °C melting point, low vapour pressure and moderate mass make it the usual choice. The column consists of extractor, suppressor, condenser lens, beam-defining aperture strip, blanker, octupole deflector/stigmator and objective lens, all electrostatic, because a heavy ion's magnetic rigidity is hundreds of times that of an electron of the same energy and magnetic lenses cannot focus it efficiently. A xenon plasma FIB replaces the liquid metal with an inductively coupled plasma source, avoiding gallium contamination and delivering microampere currents.
units.model: 磁剛度 Bρ = p/q：30 keV Ga⁺ 的 p = √(2mE) ≈ 3.34×10⁻²⁰ kg·m/s，Bρ ≈ 0.208 T·m；30 keV 電子（相對論）Bρ ≈ 5.9×10⁻⁴ T·m，相差約 350 倍。源消耗：發射電流 2.2 µA 相當於每秒 1.37×10¹³ 個離子，乘以 69.72 u 得 1.59 ng/s ≈ 5.7 µg/h；若源額定 1500 µA·h，可用約 1500/2.2 ≈ 680 小時，只計離子約消耗 3.9 mg 鎵。~Magnetic rigidity is Bρ = p/q: for 30 keV Ga⁺, p = √(2mE) ≈ 3.34×10⁻²⁰ kg·m/s and Bρ ≈ 0.208 T·m, while a relativistic 30 keV electron has Bρ ≈ 5.9×10⁻⁴ T·m, about 350 times smaller. Source consumption: a 2.2 µA emission current is 1.37×10¹³ ions per second, which at 69.72 u is 1.59 ng/s or about 5.7 µg per hour; a source rated at 1500 µA·h lasts about 1500/2.2 ≈ 680 hours and, counting ions only, consumes about 3.9 mg of gallium.
units.verify: 每天記錄維持固定發射電流所需的萃取電壓、累計 µA·h 與發射電流雜訊；萃取電壓逐步升高代表針尖形狀改變或污染，接近壽命終點。以法拉第杯連續記錄 1 小時束流，波動應小於 1%；依原廠排程進行源維護並在之後重新量測各光闌束流。~Log daily the extractor voltage needed for a fixed emission current, the accumulated µA·h and the emission-current noise; a steadily rising extractor voltage signals a changed or contaminated tip approaching end of life. Record the beam current on a Faraday cup for an hour, expecting fluctuations below 1%, perform source maintenance on the vendor schedule and re-measure every aperture current afterwards.
units.failure: 鎵儲量將盡或針尖受污染時發射不穩，束流出現尖峰與跳動，切削深度隨時間忽深忽淺，離子影像出現水平條紋；光闌條被濺射物覆蓋而局部帶電，束流位置緩慢漂移，長時間圖形化的邊緣錯位數十 nm。~When the gallium reservoir runs low or the tip is contaminated, emission becomes unstable with current spikes and jumps, milling depth wanders over time and ion images show horizontal streaks; an aperture strip coated with sputtered material charges locally and slowly deflects the beam, misplacing edges of long patterning jobs by tens of nanometres.
units.misconception: FIB 的離子柱和 SEM 一樣使用磁透鏡聚焦。~An FIB ion column focuses with magnetic lenses just like an SEM.

units.anchor: 共焦點、氣體注入針與偵測器~Coincident point, gas-injection needles and detectors
units.title: 雙束幾何、束誘發沉積與偵測器~Dual-beam geometry, beam-induced deposition and detectors
units.mechanism: 雙束系統把垂直的 SEM 柱與傾斜 52°（Thermo Fisher）或 54°（ZEISS）的 FIB 柱對準在同一個共焦點，平台傾到該角度時離子束垂直切入表面，SEM 則從斜上方觀察剛切出的截面，所以截面上的垂直尺寸被縮短為 sin θ 倍。氣體注入系統把有機金屬或碳氫前驅物噴到表面，由電子或離子束分解成鉑、鎢或碳的保護層與導線；電子束沉積不傷表面但慢，離子束沉積快但含鎵與碳並會破壞最上層。偵測器包含 Everhart–Thornley、柱內二次電子與背散射電子、離子誘發二次電子（晶粒通道對比），以及 EDS、EBSD 與微操作器。~A dual-beam system aligns the vertical SEM column and an FIB column tilted at 52° (Thermo Fisher) or 54° (ZEISS) on one coincident point; with the stage tilted to that angle the ion beam mills perpendicular to the surface while the SEM views the freshly cut face obliquely, so vertical dimensions in the cross-section are foreshortened by sin θ. The gas-injection system jets organometallic or hydrocarbon precursors onto the surface, where the electron or ion beam decomposes them into platinum, tungsten or carbon caps and conductors; electron-beam deposition is gentle but slow, while ion-beam deposition is fast but contains gallium and carbon and damages the top layer. Detectors include Everhart–Thornley, in-column secondary and backscattered electron detectors, ion-induced secondary electrons with grain-channelling contrast, plus EDS, EBSD and a micromanipulator.
units.model: 平台傾斜 52° 時 SEM 看到的截面高度 = 真實高度 × sin 52° = 0.788 倍，影像上量到 158 nm 的膜層實際為 158/0.788 ≈ 200 nm；若傾角誤差 0.5°，sin 52.5°/sin 52° = 1.0068，厚度誤差 0.7%。共焦高度偏離 Δz = 5 µm 時，傾斜 52° 會讓兩束影像相對錯開 Δz·sin 52° ≈ 3.9 µm，足以讓 FIB 切到目標旁邊。~With the stage tilted 52°, the SEM sees cross-section heights multiplied by sin 52° = 0.788, so a layer measuring 158 nm in the image is really 158/0.788 ≈ 200 nm; a 0.5° tilt error gives sin 52.5°/sin 52° = 1.0068, a 0.7% thickness error. A coincidence-height error Δz = 5 µm shifts the two beam images by Δz·sin 52° ≈ 3.9 µm at 52° tilt, enough for the FIB to cut beside the target.
units.verify: 以樣品特徵在 0° 與 52° 間反覆傾斜並調整 Z，直到特徵不再移動以找到共焦高度，確認 SEM 與 FIB 影像中心重合在 1 µm 內；以已知厚度的氧化層或認證膜層堆疊做截面，套用傾斜修正後與標稱值比較；比較電子束先鍍 200 nm 再離子束加厚與直接離子束沉積的表層截面差異。~Find the coincidence height by tilting a feature between 0° and 52° and adjusting Z until it stops moving, then confirm that the SEM and FIB image centres coincide within 1 µm; cross-section an oxide or certified film stack of known thickness and compare the tilt-corrected value with the nominal; compare top-surface cross-sections made with a 200 nm electron-beam cap thickened by ion deposition against direct ion deposition.
units.failure: 省略電子束保護層而直接以離子束沉積鉑，最上面 20–30 nm 被非晶化並植入鎵，薄閘極介電層或二維材料在觀察前就已毀損；量測截面時忘了傾斜修正，所有厚度系統性低估 21%，製程窗口判斷錯誤。~Skipping the electron-beam cap and depositing platinum directly with ions amorphises and gallium-implants the top 20–30 nm, so a thin gate dielectric or a two-dimensional material is destroyed before it is ever imaged; forgetting the tilt correction underestimates every cross-section thickness by 21% and misjudges the process window.
units.misconception: 截面厚度可以直接從 SEM 影像讀出，不必做傾斜修正。~Cross-section thickness can be read straight from the SEM image without tilt correction.

units.anchor: TEM 薄片與非晶損傷層~TEM lamella and amorphous damage layer
units.title: TEM 薄片製備的厚度與損傷預算~Thickness and damage budget of TEM lamella preparation
units.mechanism: 提取法製備 TEM 薄片的流程是：保護層、兩側粗切溝槽、底切、以微操作器焊接取出、轉移到銅格，再以逐步降低的束流與 1–2° 過傾角補償束流錐度把薄片減薄到 100 nm 以下，高解析觀察常需 20–50 nm。每一道離子都會在兩側表面留下厚度約等於射程的非晶損傷層並植入鎵，所以最後以 5 kV 與 2 kV 低能量離子清潔，把損傷層從二十幾 nm 降到數 nm。減薄終點以 SEM 低能量影像判斷，電子穿透時二次電子對比改變；實際厚度則以 TEM 的 EELS 對數比法量測。~Lift-out preparation of a TEM lamella proceeds through a protective cap, rough trenches on both sides, an undercut, attachment and extraction with a micromanipulator, transfer to a copper grid, and thinning with stepwise lower currents and a 1–2° over-tilt that compensates the beam taper until the lamella is below 100 nm, often 20–50 nm for high-resolution work. Every pass leaves an amorphous damage layer about one ion range thick on each face and implants gallium, so the final step cleans with 5 kV and 2 kV ions to cut the damage from twenty-odd nanometres to a few. The thinning end-point is judged from low-voltage SEM images whose secondary-electron contrast changes once electrons transmit, and the actual thickness is measured in the TEM by the EELS log-ratio method.
units.model: 假設每側非晶層在 30 kV 為 22 nm、5 kV 為 6 nm、2 kV 為 2.5 nm。60 nm 薄片若只用 30 kV 收尾，結晶核心僅 60 − 2×22 = 16 nm（27%）；5 kV 清潔後為 48 nm（80%）；2 kV 清潔後為 55 nm（92%）。EELS 量得 t/λ = 0.40、矽在 200 kV 的非彈性平均自由徑假設 λ ≈ 150 nm，則厚度 t = 0.40 × 150 = 60 nm。~Assume an amorphous layer per face of 22 nm at 30 kV, 6 nm at 5 kV and 2.5 nm at 2 kV. A 60 nm lamella finished only at 30 kV keeps a crystalline core of 60 − 2×22 = 16 nm (27%); after 5 kV cleaning it is 48 nm (80%) and after 2 kV cleaning 55 nm (92%). With an EELS t/λ = 0.40 and an assumed inelastic mean free path λ ≈ 150 nm for silicon at 200 kV, the thickness is t = 0.40 × 150 = 60 nm.
units.verify: 製作兩片對照薄片：一片只用 30 kV、一片加做 5 kV 與 2 kV 清潔，在 TEM 以高解析影像量側壁非晶層厚度，並以 EELS 厚度圖檢查整片的厚度均勻度；以 EDS 或 EELS 量薄片表面的鎵訊號，比較兩種流程的鎵殘留；把 SEM 判斷的終點與 EELS 厚度對照，建立此材料的終點對比表。~Prepare two control lamellae, one finished at 30 kV only and one with additional 5 kV and 2 kV cleaning, measure the sidewall amorphous thickness in high-resolution TEM images and check thickness uniformity across each lamella with EELS thickness maps; quantify surface gallium with EDS or EELS to compare residues between the two routes; correlate the SEM end-point contrast with the EELS thickness to build an end-point table for this material.
units.failure: 軟硬交替的膜層造成簾幕效應，薄片厚度出現條紋狀起伏，定量 EDS 與應變分析失真；鋁或銅合金在鎵植入後沿晶界形成富鎵相甚至晶界脆化，TEM 看到的析出物其實是製樣產物，若據此判定材料失效將得出錯誤結論。~Alternating hard and soft layers cause curtaining, striping the lamella thickness and distorting quantitative EDS and strain analysis; in aluminium or copper alloys implanted gallium forms gallium-rich phases along grain boundaries or even embrittles them, so precipitates seen in the TEM are preparation artefacts and a failure analysis built on them reaches the wrong conclusion.
units.misconception: 薄片越薄越好，表面損傷層對 TEM 分析沒有影響。~The thinner the lamella the better; surface damage layers do not affect TEM analysis.

units.anchor: 法拉第杯、校正方塊與基準標記~Faraday cup, calibration box and fiducial mark
units.title: 束流、切削速率與尺寸量測校正~Calibrating beam current, milling rate and dimensions
units.mechanism: FIB 交給圖形的劑量是束流乘以時間，而實際束流會隨源老化、光闌磨損與聚光鏡設定而偏離標示值，所以每個光闌都要以法拉第杯量測並記錄。切削深度還取決於材料的產率表與入射角，SEM 量測又取決於像素尺寸校正與傾斜修正；長時間圖形化期間的熱漂移與帶電漂移，則以表面上的基準標記做影像相關修正。這些項目一起構成截面量測與終點判斷的不確定度預算。~The dose an FIB pattern receives is beam current times time, and the real current drifts from the labelled value with source ageing, aperture wear and condenser settings, so every aperture must be measured and logged with a Faraday cup. Milling depth further depends on the material yield table and incidence angle, SEM measurement depends on pixel calibration and tilt correction, and thermal or charging drift during long patterning is corrected by image correlation on a fiducial mark. Together these items form the uncertainty budget of cross-section metrology and end-point decisions.
units.model: 標示 1.00 nA 的光闌以法拉第杯量得 0.92 nA。在矽上切 2 × 2 × 1 µm（4 µm³）方塊，依標示值設定 4/0.275 ≈ 14.5 nC、時間 14.5 s；實際劑量 14.5 × 0.92 ≈ 13.4 nC，只移除 3.68 µm³，深度 0.92 µm，短少 8%。SEM 在 52° 下看到 0.725 µm，除以 0.788 得 0.920 µm，與預測一致。漂移 5 nm/min、圖形化 10 分鐘則累積 50 nm 位置誤差。~An aperture labelled 1.00 nA measures 0.92 nA on the Faraday cup. Milling a 2 × 2 × 1 µm (4 µm³) box in silicon with the labelled value sets 4/0.275 ≈ 14.5 nC and 14.5 s, but the real dose is 14.5 × 0.92 ≈ 13.4 nC, removing only 3.68 µm³ to a depth of 0.92 µm, 8% short. The SEM at 52° sees 0.725 µm, and dividing by 0.788 gives 0.920 µm, matching the prediction. A 5 nm/min drift over 10 minutes of patterning accumulates a 50 nm placement error.
units.verify: 每天以法拉第杯量所有常用光闌的束流並與歷史趨勢比較，偏差超過 5% 即更新劑量表；每週在矽上切標準方塊並以截面量深度驗證 µm³/nC；以節距標準片校正 SEM 與離子影像的像素尺寸；長時間工作時每 2–5 分鐘以基準標記量漂移並由軟體自動修正。~Measure the current of every frequently used aperture on the Faraday cup daily and compare with its history, updating the dose table when the deviation exceeds 5%; mill a standard box in silicon weekly and verify µm³/nC from the cross-section depth; calibrate SEM and ion-image pixel sizes on a pitch standard; during long jobs measure drift on a fiducial every 2–5 minutes and let the software correct it automatically.
units.failure: 依標示束流與時間切到某金屬層的終點，實際束流低 8% 讓切削停在目標上方而誤判為斷線，或束流偏高時切穿目標層；未做漂移修正的長時間圖形化讓多層截面的各階段錯位，量到的線寬與間距混入數十 nm 的假偏差。~Cutting to a metal layer by labelled current and time stops 8% short of the target when the real current is low, which is misread as an open circuit, or punches through the target when the current is high; long patterning without drift correction misregisters successive stages of a multilayer cross-section, adding false deviations of tens of nanometres to measured widths and spacings.
units.misconception: 光闌標示的束流值就是實際打到樣品上的束流。~The current printed on an aperture is the current actually reaching the sample.

units.anchor: 切片—成像循環與體素~Slice-and-view cycle and voxels
units.title: FIB-SEM 切片斷層與分析整合~FIB-SEM slice-and-view tomography and analytical integration
units.mechanism: 切片斷層把 FIB 切一層、SEM 拍一張的循環重複數百到數千次，重建出奈米解析度的三維體積，並可同步取得 EDS 成分或 EBSD 晶向。系統整合的關鍵是：切片厚度要等於或接近影像像素以得到等向體素，SEM 影像在傾斜下的 y 方向需做 1/sin θ 修正，整段數小時的漂移要靠基準標記追蹤，而離子源穩定度、帶電與簾幕效應會在整個體積中留下系統誤差。資料量與時間預算也必須在開始前算好，否則實驗會在半途因儲存或源壽命而中斷。~Slice-and-view tomography repeats a cycle of one FIB slice and one SEM image hundreds to thousands of times to reconstruct a nanometre-resolution volume, optionally with simultaneous EDS composition or EBSD orientation. The integration keys are a slice thickness equal or close to the image pixel for isotropic voxels, a 1/sin θ correction of the tilted SEM image's y axis, fiducial tracking of drift over many hours, and awareness that source stability, charging and curtaining leave systematic errors throughout the volume. The data volume and time budget must be calculated before starting, or the run stops halfway on storage or source life.
units.model: 體積 20 × 20 × 10 µm、切片 10 nm 共 1000 層；每張 SEM 影像 2048 × 1536 像素、每像素 3 µs 需 9.4 s，加上每層切削 20 s，每層約 29.4 s，總計約 8.2 小時；8 位元影像共約 3.1 GB。x 方向像素 20 µm/2048 = 9.8 nm，傾斜 52° 下 y 方向真實尺寸為 9.8/0.788 = 12.4 nm，需重新取樣才得到等向體素。漂移 2 nm/min 在 8.2 小時累積近 1 µm，必須以基準追蹤修正。~A 20 × 20 × 10 µm volume at 10 nm slices is 1000 slices; each 2048 × 1536 SEM image at 3 µs per pixel takes 9.4 s, plus 20 s of milling, about 29.4 s per slice and 8.2 hours in total, with about 3.1 GB of 8-bit images. The x pixel is 20 µm/2048 = 9.8 nm, while at 52° tilt the true y size is 9.8/0.788 = 12.4 nm, so resampling is needed for isotropic voxels. A 2 nm/min drift accumulates nearly 1 µm over 8.2 hours and must be corrected by fiducial tracking.
units.verify: 在體積旁切一對斜向基準線，其在每張截面上的間距變化直接編碼實際切削深度，用來量每層真實厚度並與標稱 10 nm 比較；以已知幾何的結構（如節距已知的接觸孔陣列）重建後量其尺寸驗證三軸比例；整段過程記錄漂移修正量與束流，並在重建前檢查影像亮度與對焦的趨勢。~Mill a pair of inclined fiducial lines beside the volume whose separation on each face encodes the true milled depth, measuring each slice's real thickness against the nominal 10 nm; reconstruct a structure of known geometry, such as a contact array of known pitch, and measure it to verify the three axis scales; log drift corrections and beam current throughout and check trends in image brightness and focus before reconstruction.
units.failure: 未量實際切片厚度，假設每層 10 nm 而實際平均 12 nm，重建體積在 z 方向縮短 17%，孔隙率與連通度計算錯誤；夜間離子源不穩讓數十層切得過厚，三維模型出現跳層，若沒有基準線就無從發現。~Assuming 10 nm slices without measuring them when the real average is 12 nm compresses the reconstructed volume by 17% in z and corrupts porosity and connectivity results; overnight source instability that over-mills tens of slices creates jumps in the 3D model, which cannot be detected without fiducial lines.
units.misconception: 切片厚度就等於設定的步距，不需要另外量測。~Slice thickness equals the programmed step and needs no separate measurement.

units.anchor: 驗收樣品與光闌束流表~Acceptance samples and aperture-current table
units.title: 系統驗收與工程交接~System acceptance and engineering handoff
units.mechanism: FIB 分析系統的驗收把前面的模型逐一轉成測試：錫球或金顆粒樣品驗證離子與電子影像解析度，法拉第杯驗證每個光闌的束流，矽標準方塊驗證切削速率，共焦點與傾斜修正以已知膜層截面驗證，對照薄片驗證損傷層與鎵殘留，長時間圖形化驗證漂移，切片斷層以基準線驗證切片厚度。交接紀錄須包含光闌束流表、材料切削速率表、源的累計 µA·h 與萃取電壓趨勢、氣體注入系統的沉積參數，以及每種分析流程的標準作業參數，任何一項更新都要重新驗證。~Acceptance of an FIB analysis system turns each earlier model into a test: tin-sphere or gold-particle samples verify ion and electron image resolution, the Faraday cup verifies every aperture current, standard silicon boxes verify milling rate, a known film-stack cross-section verifies the coincident point and tilt correction, control lamellae verify damage layers and gallium residue, long patterning verifies drift, and fiducial lines verify slice thickness in tomography. The handoff record must hold the aperture-current table, the material milling-rate table, the source's accumulated µA·h and extractor-voltage trend, gas-injection deposition parameters and the standard settings of each analytical workflow, and any update requires re-verification.
units.model: 驗收範例：1 pA 離子影像 20–80% 邊緣解析度 3.5 nm，低於 4 nm 允收值；各光闌實測束流與標示差 −8% 到 +4%，全部寫入劑量表後重切矽方塊得 0.27 ± 0.01 µm³/nC，與模型 0.275 相符；共焦點偏差 0.6 µm（允收 ≤ 1 µm）；2 kV 清潔後薄片側壁非晶層 2–3 nm；漂移 1.8 nm/min（允收 ≤ 5 nm/min）；源累計 420 µA·h，以 2.2 µA 計剩約 490 小時。~Example acceptance: ion-image 20–80% edge resolution at 1 pA is 3.5 nm, inside the 4 nm allowance; measured aperture currents differ from their labels by −8% to +4%, and after entering them in the dose table a re-milled silicon box gives 0.27 ± 0.01 µm³/nC, consistent with the 0.275 model; coincident-point error is 0.6 µm against an allowance of 1 µm; lamella sidewall amorphous layers after 2 kV cleaning are 2–3 nm; drift is 1.8 nm/min against 5 nm/min; the source has accumulated 420 µA·h, leaving about 490 hours at 2.2 µA.
units.verify: 依固定順序執行：真空與源狀態、各光闌法拉第杯束流、離子與電子解析度、共焦點與傾斜修正、矽切削速率、對照薄片損傷層、30 分鐘漂移、切片斷層基準線試跑；每項結果與模型值並列，超出允收值時記錄原因並重做，最後把束流表、速率表與流程參數一起交接並設定下次驗證日期。~Execute in a fixed order: vacuum and source status, Faraday-cup current of every aperture, ion and electron resolution, coincident point and tilt correction, silicon milling rate, control-lamella damage layers, 30-minute drift and a fiducial-line tomography trial; enter each result beside its model value, record the cause and repeat any item outside its allowance, and finally hand over the current table, rate table and workflow settings together with the next verification date.
units.failure: 交接時沒有光闌束流表，新使用者依標示值設定劑量，薄片減薄步驟用錯束流而在最後一步切穿；源的萃取電壓趨勢沒有被追蹤，源在關鍵的過夜斷層實驗中途失效，數百層資料無法拼接。~Without an aperture-current table at handoff, new users set doses from the labels, choose the wrong current in a thinning step and punch through the lamella at the last step; with no tracking of the extractor-voltage trend the source fails midway through a critical overnight tomography run and hundreds of slices cannot be stitched.
units.misconception: FIB 在安裝時對準一次後，就會一直保持對準。~Once an FIB is aligned at installation it stays aligned forever.

example: TEM 薄片製程預算練習（矽，0.275 µm³/nC）：兩側粗切溝槽各 15 × 8 × 6 µm，共 1440 µm³，需 1440/0.275 ≈ 5240 nC，以 9 nA 約 9.7 分鐘；把 2 µm 厚的薄片在 15 × 6 µm 範圍減薄到 0.5 µm，移除 135 µm³ 需 491 nC，以 1 nA 約 8.2 分鐘；最後在 10 × 5 µm 視窗由 0.5 µm 減到 0.1 µm，移除 20 µm³ 需 72.7 nC，以 0.1 nA 約 12 分鐘，30 kV 切削合計約 30 分鐘。若只以 30 kV 收尾到 60 nm，每側 22 nm 非晶層讓結晶核心只剩 16 nm；加做 5 kV 與 2 kV 清潔後每側約 2.5 nm，核心 55 nm（92%）。若精修光闌實際束流比標示低 8% 而未校正，最後一步只移除 18.4 µm³，薄片停在約 0.13 µm，需要額外 1 分鐘補切。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。~TEM-lamella process budget for silicon at 0.275 µm³/nC: two rough trenches of 15 × 8 × 6 µm total 1440 µm³ and need 1440/0.275 ≈ 5240 nC, about 9.7 minutes at 9 nA; thinning the 2 µm lamella over 15 × 6 µm to 0.5 µm removes 135 µm³ with 491 nC, about 8.2 minutes at 1 nA; finally thinning a 10 × 5 µm window from 0.5 to 0.1 µm removes 20 µm³ with 72.7 nC, about 12 minutes at 0.1 nA, for about 30 minutes of 30 kV milling in all. Finishing at 30 kV only to 60 nm leaves 22 nm of amorphous material per face and a crystalline core of just 16 nm; adding 5 kV and 2 kV cleaning brings each face to about 2.5 nm and the core to 55 nm (92%). If the polishing aperture delivers 8% less than its label without correction, the last step removes only 18.4 µm³ and the lamella stops near 0.13 µm, needing about one more minute of milling. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.
history: 1970 年代液態金屬離子源在太空推進與表面分析研究中發展成熟，1979 年美國 Hughes Research Laboratories 的 Seliger 等人以鎵源展示次微米光點的掃描離子探針。1980 年代 FIB 用於光罩修補與積體電路修改，1990 年代 FEI 等公司把 FIB 與 SEM 結合成雙束系統，使 TEM 試片製備與失效分析成為半導體與材料實驗室的例行工作；2010 年代氙電漿 FIB 把大體積切削速度提高一個數量級以上，支援封裝與電池等大尺度截面。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。~Liquid-metal ion sources matured in the 1970s through space-propulsion and surface-analysis research, and in 1979 Seliger and colleagues at Hughes Research Laboratories demonstrated a scanning ion probe with a submicrometre spot from a gallium source. In the 1980s FIBs were used for mask repair and integrated-circuit modification, and in the 1990s FEI and others combined FIB and SEM into dual-beam systems that made TEM specimen preparation and failure analysis routine in semiconductor and materials laboratories; in the 2010s xenon plasma FIBs raised bulk removal rates by more than an order of magnitude for large cross-sections of packages and batteries. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.
